about: The seams apps depend on, each held against a baseline in release/frozen/ by scripts/check-frozen.mjs. status: frozen (only adds; a narrowing fails CI), fix-first (to be changed before it is frozen; reported, never fails), open (may still change; reported, never fails). Changing a status or moving a baseline is a decision and goes with a record. The statuses here are proposed, from the one-way doors review of 15 November 2026 at d4efc5ac: nothing is accepted until Harry accepts it.
